observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: V4 sky and ridge field flatten the campus scale hierarchy
observations.context: Preserved v13 menu fly-through and all five player-eye route frames
observations.expectation: An open-sky relay campus should separate playable decks, regional ridges, horizon haze, and upper sky at a glance
observations.actual: A nearly uniform green-gray field dominates the frame while isolated rounded ridge blobs sit at one similar visual depth
observations.playerConsequence: The arena reads as a lit graybox suspended in a blank field instead of a place with environmental scale
hypotheses: The v4 sky colors occupy too narrow a luminance and hue range
Repeated dodecahedral ridge masses do not create near, middle, and far silhouettes
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Capture the same menu and spawn cameras on v5 after the protected Blender process is absent
observations.recommendedOutcome: Retain v5 only if the playable campus separates clearly from three readable environmental depth layers

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: V4 bridge slabs and spawn beacon read as unsupported kit parts
observations.context: V13 spawn-active, route-one, route-two, and movement-contact frames
observations.action: Trace the visible load path from bridge deck to supports and scan the central combat sightline
observations.expectation: Bridge structure should explain how decks are carried while navigation markers remain outside the aiming lane
observations.actual: Pale slab edges float over narrow dark posts and a tall black mast with a glowing cap resembles a streetlamp directly in the route read
observations.playerConsequence: The first-person view prioritizes construction gaps and an obstruction-like prop over authored campus identity
reproduction: Compare the bridge underside and beacon in v13 frames 05 through 07
hypotheses: The bridge fascia is not visually continuous with its support collars
The beacon silhouette borrows street furniture proportions instead of wall-bound relay infrastructure
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Use the identical spawn and route cameras to verify v5 capitals, rail braces, underside bands, and removal of both beacon masts
observations.recommendedOutcome: A continuous bridge load path and wall-bound spawn identity should replace the floating-slab and lamp reads

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: V4 cover and boundary surfaces repeat one panel-box grammar
observations.context: V13 menu overview and central route frames
observations.action: Compare cover, rails, facades, and deck surfacing at near and mid range
observations.expectation: Gameplay roles should remain collision-truthful while using distinct material and silhouette cues
observations.actual: Square panel grids repeat across exposed collider boxes, long walls, and equipment housings with little role separation
observations.playerConsequence: Cover and architecture look procedurally assembled and different areas are harder to remember from cropped views
reproduction: Inspect cover at center-left and center-right in frames 05 and 06
hypotheses: One square-grid procedural map is reused too broadly
Four repeated north equipment boxes amplify the kit-like massing
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect v5 chevron cover armor, deck strakes, edge louvers, service grates, and absence of north equipment boxes at the same distances
observations.recommendedOutcome: Keep collision truth while making surface role and area identity readable without a repeated locker-grid motif

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: V4 cyan floor wash clips local material information
observations.context: V13 spawn-active, route-two, and movement-contact frames
observations.action: Inspect the west spawn and lower-left route surfaces around the active readability light
observations.expectation: Team-side color should orient the player without erasing floor texture or competing with the crosshair
observations.actual: Large cyan-white patches bloom across the floor and dominate nearby neutral materials
observations.playerConsequence: The route looks cheaper, surface detail disappears, and team color becomes glare instead of information
reproduction: Compare the cyan floor patch in frames 06 and 07
hypotheses: Spawn point-light intensity and range are too high for the dark floor response
Several emissive inlays stack in the same view
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Compare histogram and retained floor detail in the v5 spawn-active frame
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use low-output wall-bound signals with floor detail preserved around the entire spawn route

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: V5 preserves authority identity and stays under its explicit base-art budget
observations.context: Consolidated source gate on the isolated v5 worktree
observations.action: Run app typecheck, Relay unit tests, targeted Relay Worker test, changed-file lint, and production build
observations.expectation: Art remains no-hit behind 56 colliders, 8 spawns, 8 zones, linked portals, and a bounded render construction
observations.actual: All requested gates passed; deterministic construction accounts for 54 base meshes/draw calls, 6 lights, 22 architectural batches, and 122 architectural logical instances
observations.playerConsequence: Practice/online authority parity and performance guardrails remain testable while presentation iterates
reproduction: Run the four Relay unit files and targeted Relay Worker test from the worktree
hypotheses: No authority drift is present because only the presentation reference changed in relayAuthority.ts
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Verify the same counts in a source-matched browser snapshot when capture is permitted
observations.recommendedOutcome: KEEP the authority isolation and render budget contracts

observations.label: INFERRED
observations.title: V5 source directly addresses the rejected construction relationships
observations.context: White-box review after the v13 cold-eye pass
observations.action: Map each baseline failure to the completed v5 render-only source change
observations.expectation: The revision should change silhouette, load path, area identity, material grammar, and light placement rather than only recolor the graybox
observations.actual: The source replaces the ring, beacons, ridge blobs, repeated equipment boxes, shared panel grid, disconnected portal trim, and high-output spawn lights with distinct connected systems
observations.playerConsequence: The candidate is directionally more authored, but source structure cannot prove its actual player-eye composition
reproduction: Review src/app/relayArchitectureSkin.ts against OBS-001 through OBS-004
hypotheses: The connected v5 systems will produce a clearer campus read at player eye
Some new facade or ridge proportions may still need revision after capture
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Run the bounded v5 capture with the preserved v13 route once no protected Blender or Unreal process is active
observations.recommendedOutcome: KEEP the source direction but withhold visual acceptance

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: V5 player-eye appearance and motion remain uncaptured
observations.context: Protected-process preflight immediately after the green source gate
observations.action: Check for Blender or Unreal before starting the bounded browser capture
observations.expectation: No protected Blender or Unreal process is active
observations.actual: Blender 5.1 was active as PID 30588, started at 2026-08-09 14:27:29 local time; the browser capture was not launched
observations.playerConsequence: No claim can be made about v5 composition, clipping, lighting balance, route readability, portal connection in motion, or subjective quality
reproduction: Observe the active blender process and stop before browser launch
hypotheses: The process belongs to another protected visual-production lane
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Repeat the read-only process check later and capture only if Blender and Unreal are both absent
observations.recommendedOutcome: Treat v5 visuals as UNKNOWN and require owner-facing player-eye review before any acceptance decision
